articles.title: History and mission
articles.text: TradersYard’s timeline: 2020 foundation; 2021–22 community growth; 2023 Andromeda backing; 2024 prop-firm launch; 2025 expansion. The Austrian firm emphasises fair conditions and trader development.

articles.title: 1-Step evaluation
articles.text: The 1-Step evaluation requires its profit target, profitable days, consistency and risk conditions to be met. Daily drawdown includes open P&L and resets at 00:00 UTC. EoD drawdown can trail upward and eventually lock. The public article contains ambiguous wording about numeric limits and profitable days; use the individual account dashboard for exact thresholds.

articles.title: 1-Step trading conditions
articles.text: The 1-Step guide prohibits copy trading, cross-account hedging, latency exploitation, gambling and VPN/VPS use. It restricts martingale/grid methods, limits margin on an individual trade to 70% of balance, and requires a trade within each 30-day period. After a losing streak, a new position cannot exceed twice the largest losing position's notional size. News restrictions cover 10 minutes before through 5 minutes after high-impact events. Overnight holding is allowed.

articles.title: 2-Step evaluation
articles.text: The current 2-Step guide lists a 9% target in Phase 1 and 6% in Phase 2, six profitable days, 5% daily drawdown and 10% static maximum drawdown. Older or configured accounts can differ; the synced account thresholds take priority.

articles.title: 2-Step profitable days and consistency
articles.text: The current 2-Step guide requires six profitable days and states that this plan has no consistency ratio requirement. Do not assume the 40% ratio used by other products applies to a 2-Step account.

articles.title: Futures EoD drawdown
articles.text: Futures Standard uses 3% EoD trailing drawdown and Premium 4%. The floor updates at 17:00 New York time when the reference high increases; it never falls. It stops trailing at the initial balance. After a payout, the next cycle uses the initial-balance floor. This is an account floor, not the journal's closed-trade drawdown metric.

articles.title: Futures trading conditions
articles.text: Futures positions must close before the 17:00 New York reset. News restrictions run from 10 minutes before to 5 minutes after high-impact releases, including system execution of pending orders. Profit from trades under ten seconds is capped at 30% of total closed profit; excess is deducted. The guide also prohibits latency/arbitrage exploitation, cross-account hedging, unauthorised copying, third-party management, gambling-like churning and VPN/VPS use.

articles.title: Futures reward eligibility
articles.text: Funded Futures has no evaluation profit target. Both plans require at least 1% cycle profit and a minimum payout of 1% of initial balance; at most 50% of available profit can be used, subject to caps and split. Standard requires five profitable days with daily closed profit at least 0.4% of initial balance and has no funded consistency ratio. Premium has no minimum profitable days but requires consistency below 40%. Allocation permits five funded accounts, at most two Premium. The guide lists a $100,000 combined funded cap for Malaysia, Pakistan, Indonesia and India; never infer a user's nationality. Eligibility does not guarantee approval.

articles.title: Futures rewards and risk review
articles.text: The Futures guide permits a first reward request after ten days, then ten-day intervals subject to eligibility. Risk review can examine history, patterns, violations and account churning. The team may impose a 30-day trading suspension. Eligible funded accounts unblock on calendar day 30. Only TradersYard can confirm why an individual account was blocked or whether it is eligible.
